claim(CoreState storage,bytes32).notice: Burn the caller's C (pro-rata quote and defaulted asset) and free R (pro-rata auction surplus).

closeWindow(CoreState storage,bytes32,ui.notice: Segmented close: each call fills at most `maxBids` bids from the top, then refunds them. Unrepaid units nobody bid on stay in the pool for C holders (default). Returns true once Closed.

repay(CoreState storage,Params,bytes32,u.notice: Pay K per whole asset (rounded up) to buy back `units`. American: any time until the window ends. European: only inside the window. The spread share comes out of what is paid.
